name: Send Document or PDF via WhatsApp with Supergreen

parameters.content:
## Send Document or PDF via WhatsApp with Supergreen

### How it works

This workflow receives an incoming webhook request and uses the received data to send a document or PDF through WhatsApp using Supergreen. The webhook acts as the entry point, then passes execution directly to the Supergreen node that performs the message delivery.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Incoming Webhook URL in n8n and share it with the system that will trigger PDF or document sends.
- Set up Supergreen credentials/API access in n8n for the Supergreen Send PDF node.
- Configure the Supergreen node with the target WhatsApp recipient, document/PDF URL or binary field, filename, and any required message parameters from the webhook payload.
- Test the webhook with a sample payload to confirm the document is delivered successfully.

### Customization

Adjust the webhook payload mapping in the Supergreen node to support different recipients, document URLs, filenames, captions, or message templates.

## Receive and send PDF

A compact two-node flow that starts from an incoming webhook and immediately sends the requested PDF or document via WhatsApp using Supergreen.
